answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow: through the single narrow inlet, each locks 60 POA; real work stamps its fingerprint—timing, cadence, counterparties—in umber ink. The print must stay consistent to unlock it. 1,000 clones leave 1,000 identical prints; falcon-eyed clustering spots the herd and freezes each escrow. One forged print costs 15 POA, so 1,000 fakes pay 75,000 POA for 500 POA, a 74,500 loss. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
